title: Highlight the model menu row under the cursor
description: User request 2026-10-03, follow-on to VIEW-12: hovering a model row in the model menu highlights it (a brighter colour or a background bar across the row's full width, including all its wrapped lines), so it is clear what a click will load. The current model keeps its own marker and colour; hovering it still shows the hover state. Uses HyperString's existing hover handling; depends on VIEW-14 because hover bounds are currently about ten times too wide and would highlight the wrong rows.
definition-of-done: 1. Hovering any line of a model row highlights the whole row, and only that row (screenshots, including a wrapped row). 2. Moving off the row clears it. 3. Works in a scrolled box.
testing-plan: 1. F5 the editing scene, open the menu, hover rows at several scroll positions. 2. Automation hover route plus screenshot.
